bio: I'm a software engineer working independently with businesses on the systems they actually run on: storefronts, ordering backends, data pipelines, and the agent tooling around them.

Before that I spent a year in security operations, investigating incidents and writing detections across seven client environments. That work is why I design for least privilege by default, and why I audit what a system publishes rather than trusting what it reports about itself.

I hold a BSc with Honours Specialization in Computer Science from Western University. My honours thesis, on communication-efficient federated learning for IoT health devices, was accepted as a first-author paper at IEEE GLOBECOM 2026.
